title: Asahi Linux 7.3 report: first same-day Fedora Asahi Remix release
summary: Asahi Linux&\#x27;s 7.3 progress report, as quoted in the discussion, says Fedora Asahi Remix shipped on the same day as Fedora Linux 45 on November 3—the first time the project has achieved same-day release parity with upstream Fedora. The report otherwise covers ongoing Linux development for Apple Silicon, but the available material does not detail specific kernel, graphics, or hardware-support changes.
